name: 8d nails
source: NDS 2018 Table 12N (common wire nails), G 0.42 (SPF) column, 3/4in side member: Z = 70 lbf (smaller panel side members are in Tables 12P/12Q). Table 12.2C withdrawal (smooth shank), G 0.42: 21 lbf/in × 1 3/4in penetration.

name: 10d nails
source: NDS 2018 Table 12N (common wire nails), G 0.42 (SPF) column, 1 1/2in side member: Z = 100 lbf. Table 12.2C withdrawal (smooth shank), G 0.42: 23 lbf/in × 1 1/2in penetration.

name: 16d nails
source: NDS 2018 Table 12N (common wire nails), G 0.42 (SPF) column, 1 1/2in side member: Z = 120 lbf. Table 12.2C withdrawal (smooth shank), G 0.42: 26 lbf/in × 2in penetration.

name: Roofing nails
source: Estimate: withdrawal from NDS 2018 Table 12.2C, 0.120in nail at G 0.42 (19 lbf/in × 1in penetration); lateral not transcribed for a roofing nail, taken as 50 lbf, below the 8d (0.131in) value of 70 lbf in Table 12N.

name: Structural wood screws
source: ICC-ES ESR-2442 (GRK RSS, rev. Mar 2026) Table 3, 5/16in, 1 1/2in side member, SG 0.42: Z⊥ = 236 lbf (Z∥ 239); Table 2 withdrawal 165 lbf/in × 2 3/8in embedment.

name: Deck screws
source: NDS 2018 Table 12L (wood screws), #9 (0.177in), 1 1/2in side member, G 0.42: Z = 92 lbf; Table 12.2B withdrawal 89 lbf/in × 1 1/2in thread.

name: Metal roofing screws
fastener: #10 x 1 1/2in hex-washer-head screw with EPDM washer
source: Estimate: SFS #10 WoodZac data sheet (07/2021) gives 524 lbf ultimate pull-out at 1in in SPF; ÷ 5 as an allowable value = 105 lbf. Lateral not published; taken as 90 lbf, near the NDS Table 12L #9 wood screw value.

name: 1/2in through bolts
source: NDS 2018 Table 12A, 1/2in bolt, 1 1/2in side and main members, G 0.42: Z⊥ = 170 lbf (the lowest; Z∥ 410, Zs⊥ and Zm⊥ 240).

name: 3/8in lag screws
source: NDS 2018 Table 12J, 3/8in lag, 1 1/2in side member, G 0.42: Z⊥ = 110 lbf (Z∥ 180); Table 12.2A withdrawal 235 lbf/in × 2in thread.

name: Anchor bolts
source: NDS 2018 Table 12E, 1/2in bolt, 1 1/2in wood member to concrete, G 0.42: Z⊥ = 340 lbf (Z∥ 590); 6in minimum embedment, f'c ≥ 2500 psi. Count per IRC R403.1.6.

name: 1/2in wedge anchors
source: Simpson Strong-Bolt 2 (ICC-ES ESR-3037), TEB-A-STB2-24, 1/2in carbon steel at 2 3/4in embedment, f'c 2500 psi uncracked: static ASD allowable tension 1680 lbf, shear 1530 lbf.

name: Joist hanger
source: Simpson Strong-Tie catalog C-C-2021, face-mount hangers, LUS28, SPF/HF: download 945 lbf (100%), uplift 1000 lbf (published at 160% load duration). Sized by the joist; this is the 2x8 row.

name: Hurricane tie
source: Simpson Strong-Tie catalog C-C-2024, hurricane ties, H2.5A, SPF/HF: uplift 615 lbf (published at 160%), lateral F1 = F2 = 110 lbf.

name: Post base
source: Simpson Strong-Tie catalog C-C-2026, ABU44Z post installation: download 7570 lbf (100%), uplift 1900 lbf (160%) with (12) 0.162 x 3 1/2in nails. Published for DF/SP only; no SPF/HF value. The bearing value goes in shear_N for want of a download field.

name: Post embedded in concrete
source: Estimate: no published value. A 4x4 post set 2–3ft into a concrete pier is limited by the soil and the post, not the concrete; 1800 lbf lateral and 1350 lbf pull-out are conservative planning numbers, not design values.

name: Cast in place
source: Estimate: monolithic concrete poured together (slab and thickened edge) acts as one piece; 4500 lbf is a placeholder that never governs, not a design value.

name: Rebar embedded in concrete
source: Estimate: a #4 grade 60 bar fully developed (ACI 318 development length) carries 0.4·fy·As = 0.4 × 60,000 × 0.20 = 4800 lbf in tension at working stress; shear taken as 0.6 of that.

name: Mortared joint
source: Estimate: unreinforced bed-joint shear of an 8in block in Type S mortar (TMS 402 context), about 1000 lbf per block length; grout and rebar for anything structural.

name: Notched (bearing)
source: Estimate: bearing of a 1 1/2in member on a 1 1/2in seat at Fc⊥ = 425 psi (SPF, NDS 2018 Supplement Table 4A) = 956 lbf; notch limits in NDS 2018 §3.4.3 are not checked.

name: Mortise and tenon
source: Estimate: a pegged mortise and tenon in softwood, 500 lbf; rare in a shell and not a design value.

name: PVC solvent-weld fitting
source: Estimate: plumbing joints carry no structural rating; listed so the materials list counts one fitting per joint. The 50 lbf is a nominal placeholder so the solver can hold a pipe's own weight, not a design value.

name: CPVC solvent-weld fitting
source: Estimate: plumbing joints carry no structural rating; listed so the materials list counts one fitting per joint. The 50 lbf is a nominal placeholder so the solver can hold a pipe's own weight, not a design value.

name: ABS solvent-weld fitting
source: Estimate: plumbing joints carry no structural rating; listed so the materials list counts one fitting per joint. The 50 lbf is a nominal placeholder so the solver can hold a pipe's own weight, not a design value.

name: PEX crimp fitting
fastener: PEX brass insert fitting and copper crimp ring
source: Estimate: plumbing joints carry no structural rating; listed so the materials list counts one fitting per joint. The 50 lbf is a nominal placeholder so the solver can hold a pipe's own weight, not a design value.

name: Sweated copper fitting
fastener: Wrought copper fitting, flux and lead-free solder
source: Estimate: plumbing joints carry no structural rating; listed so the materials list counts one fitting per joint. The 50 lbf is a nominal placeholder so the solver can hold a pipe's own weight, not a design value.

name: Threaded galvanized fitting
fastener: Galvanized malleable iron fitting and thread sealant
source: Estimate: plumbing joints carry no structural rating; listed so the materials list counts one fitting per joint. The 50 lbf is a nominal placeholder so the solver can hold a pipe's own weight, not a design value.

name: No-hub coupling
fastener: Neoprene sleeve with stainless shield and band clamps
source: Estimate: plumbing joints carry no structural rating; listed so the materials list counts one fitting per joint. The 50 lbf is a nominal placeholder so the solver can hold a pipe's own weight, not a design value.

name: Welded steel connection
source: Estimate: weld capacity depends on the weld size and length, which aren't modelled; 1000 lbf is a placeholder for a small fillet-welded connection, not a design value. Steel members aren't checked by the solver.

name: Gate hinges
fastener: Heavy-duty gate hinge pair with screws
source: Estimate: residential gate hinges publish no lateral rating; 150 lbf per pair is a planning number for a 4ft gate leaf hanging from two hinges.

name: Self-closing gate hinges
fastener: Self-closing gate hinge pair (pool rated) with screws
source: Estimate: spring and adjustable-tension self-closing hinges publish no lateral rating; 150 lbf per pair is a planning number for a 4ft gate leaf.

name: Gate latch
source: Estimate: a gravity latch only holds the gate shut; 50 lbf is a placeholder, not a rating.

name: Magnetic pool gate latch
fastener: Magnetic self-latching pool gate latch, top-pull, with screws
source: Estimate: a magnetic self-latching pool latch only holds the gate shut; 50 lbf is a placeholder, not a rating.

name: Glass fence spigot
source: Estimate: frameless glass spigots are sized by the maker for the panel and the barrier load (often 50 lbf at the top rail); 500 lbf lateral per spigot is a planning number. The spigot core-drills into a concrete deck or bolts to a base plate.

name: Shade sail mounting kit
fastener: Stainless pad eye, turnbuckle and snap hook
source: Estimate: shade-sail turnbuckle and pad-eye kits publish breaking loads, not working loads; 500 lbf is a conservative planning number per corner. Sail corner loads in wind can be much higher: check the post with a pro.
